prompts.name: layoutHeroCutout

Output a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG alpha cutout of BOTH MEN WITH BOTH LEATHER CHAIRS as one group. Preserve the exact input faces, hair, glasses, skin tone, clothing, hands, crossed legs, watches, leather chairs, original perspective, original poses and relative positions PIXEL-FAITHFULLY. Do not regenerate, beautify, repaint or change any person. Keep chair feet or bottom crop as in source. Remove the negative space above their heads to transparent, and remove background visible between figures. No background shadow, no ground plane, no checkerboard baked into image, no navy or black backdrop, no text. Keep original wide composition and proportions.
